messages:
Sam Cheng: Heads-up — trying to align rerank scoring envelope for the new console ratecap UI. Current debate: return per-candidate 'score' (float) vs 'score_units' (int) + provenance. Thoughts?
Dalia Morgan: prefer score_units for quota billing; floats are ambiguous and hard to tie to cost.
Mike Park: +1 on units, but UX consumers mostly care about relative score. We need both without doubling payload for mobile.
Anya Iyer: what about returning a compact envelope: score for immediate UX, units for billing in metadata? e.g. scores: [{id, score}], meta: {units: [{id,units,model}]}
Ruth Gomez: double payload increases bandwidth — some mobile clients will choke on extra arrays. If we separate it, make units optional via header or query flag.
Sam Cheng: agree. Proposal: default keep old shape (scores: [float]) for backward compat; new header 'X-Include-Units: true' returns extended envelope. That keeps canaries safe.
ops-bot: deploy: rerank-api/v2 rollouts started — canary -> 10% (2026-03-18 02:14 UTC) :rocket:
Dalia Morgan: billing needs deterministic mapping between units and cost. That mapping must live in model-catalog and be encoded in the response provenance (model_version, quantization_tag).
Mike Park: also need a request-level hint so routing can pick a cheaper variant: add optional request field `model_hint: "rank-small-v2"`. Router uses it to prefer quantized replicas.
Anya Iyer: console rollout UX: when units show up, we need a toggle + tooltip: "score_units are billing integers (not normalized confidences)". Also surface model_variant in per-route rows.
Sam Cheng: telemetry: include fanout_count, model_variant, and selected_units in the trace. Add these to per-route dashboard so PMs can correlate cost vs accuracy.
Ruth Gomez: telemetry budget question — storing everything for high-volume tenants is expensive. Suggest sampling 10% of requests for full provenance; send lightweight aggregates at 100%.
Dalia Morgan: edge case: if we fallback to baseline model due to capacity, billing must still be deterministic. Add 'fallback_to' field in trace and ensure units mapping for fallback is present.
Mike Park: sample payload example for extended envelope:
```json
{
  "candidates": ["id1","id2"],
  "scores": [{"id":"id1","score":0.87}],
  "meta": {"units": [{"id":"id1","units":3,"model":"rank-v2-quant"}], "fanout":4}
}
```
Anya Iyer: API compatibility: propose content negotiation header `Accept: application/vnd.redwood.rerank.v2+json` for the new envelope. Default stays v1.
Sam Cheng: sounds good. Acceptance criteria for the change: backward compatible default, header opt-in, single PR for runtime+catalog+console mockups. I'll draft RFC and link mocks.
Dalia Morgan: cc @security-bot — please confirm provenance fields don't leak PII (model names, tenant ids ok; no prompt snippets).
security-bot: acknowledged — will review RFC for PII surface and report any concerns.
Sam Cheng: thanks all :thumbsup:
